name: 14620 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14620 (Rochester) has 145 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14620 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14620 (Rochester) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 55 organizations here; 10% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
